history.summary: THIS IS A JAIN (SHWETAMBAR) TEMPLE, NOT A HINDU TEMPLE - keep-or-drop decision needed. Shri Vasupujya Swami Jain Derasar is a Shwetambar Jain temple in the Bamroli Road area of Godhra, Panchmahal district, dedicated to Vasupujya Swami, the 12th Jain Tirthankara (whose symbol is the buffalo). Listed in the Jainstavan temple directory and on Justdial; no reliable source gives its founding date or builder.

name: Shri Vasupujya Swami Jain Derasar
town_description: Godhra is the administrative headquarters of Panchmahal district in east-central Gujarat and a commercial town described as a road and rail junction. It is a historic market centre for timber and agricultural produce, best known nationally for the 2002 train-burning incident and ensuing riots. The town hosts temples of several traditions, including Jain derasars and the Dada Bhagwan Trimandir on its outskirts.
